EuroJackpot Results

The EuroJackpot lottery is a weekly lotto draw, taking place on a Tuesday and Friday at 21:00 Eastern European Time (19:00 GMT). Are you the lucky winner? Here's where you will find the latest EuroJackpot results. Good luck!

Do you have a winning ticket?

The EuroJackpot has 12 different prize tiers. The minimum starting jackpot size is €10 million, and can reach an impressive €120 million. To win the jackpot, you will need to match all seven numbers - including the five main numbers (from 1 - 50) plus the two Euro Numbers (from 1-12).

Lower prizes can be won by matching two main numbers plus one Euro Number. It's always best to double check your ticket! If you are a LottosOnline customer, we will notify you of any lottery winnings - big or small - via email.

Are you ready to get the ball rolling and turn your lottery dreams into a reality? Let's play!

Draws are conducted every Tuesday and Friday.
